change: Persist recoverable logistics intent and original saved inventory, link production checkpoints, and add correlated Core receipt/player-balance probes before and after a normal process restart.

implementation.journal_commit: Flush complete sibling file before rename; exclusive initial creation uses a hard link. Interrupted writes/flushes/renames leave the previous journal intact.
implementation.resume: Reconcile persisted pre-command IDs and known orders; observe prior actions without dispatching them again; continue undispatched actions after checking live SQLite state and inventory.
implementation.ambiguous_or_missing_outcome: Stop for inspection; do not resend recorded commands, delete old journals, or replay an uncertain payment.
implementation.legacy_v1_journals: Require manual inspection because they lack the new recovery baselines.
implementation.production: Archive survival NBT before/after each run, hash client action logs and source binaries, check checkpoint continuity, and account for acquisition and recipe inputs. Initial stock starts with zero provenance credit.
implementation.production_flags: Linking six successful phases does not imply sufficient traced quantities. Unproven quantities remain explicit; survivalProductionVerified is conditional on sufficient traced inputs/outputs.
implementation.replay: Optional nativeReplay plan runs public Core retries before normal stop; logistics-replay starts a separate process and requires different probe boot IDs, fresh correlation IDs, identical receipts, unchanged original settlement/consumption rows, unchanged independently read player balance and unchanged player NBT.

tests.final_production_tightening: After the complete suite, honey acquisition was tightened to require traced consumed bottles. All five production evidence tests passed again; this is a rerun, not five additional tests.
tests.final_native_replay_check: Historical-row matching was changed to set lookups to avoid quadratic scans of existing consumption history. All three native replay tests passed again; not additional tests.
tests.sqlite: Actual v1-v11 migrations in disposable databases; gameplay commands and Core responses are simulated.
tests.faults: Write/flush/rename errors; response loss after buy/sell/ship/accept/deliver; pending settlement; ambiguous creations; expired shipments; changed identities; stale/same-boot Core evidence; balance/receipt changes; forged inventory-only production claims and broken checkpoint hashes.
tests.nbt_unit_fixtures: Production-linkage unit tests use hashed fixture bytes; they do not claim real Minecraft NBT or a live production run.

live_acceptance.reason: User requested runnable development/tests first and retained live acceptance as pending; last observed free memory remained below the minimum test-server threshold.
